arabic_text: أَيُّ النَّاسِ أَفْضَلُ؟ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: مُؤْمِنٌ يُجَاهِدُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ بِنَفْسِهِ وَمَالِهِ
english_translation: Which of the people is best? The Messenger of Allah said: A believer who strives in the way of Allah with his person and his wealth.
question: What does the phrase 'يُجَاهِدُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ بِنَفْسِهِ وَمَالِهِ' mean?

options.A: One who prays regularly at the mosque with devotion
options.B: One who fasts during Ramadan with sincerity
options.C: One who strives in the way of Allah with his person and his wealth
options.D: One who performs Hajj every year with family
